dispositions.topic_text: Test proving per-section rounding occurs before summation
Whether currency-rejection tests must assert the currency_mismatch typed code
Required INV-037 coverage for all derived and returned monetary values
dispositions.what: INV-037 on derived and returned money values: the derived views' amounts (completed work, balances, remaining materials, totals) carry 2 fraction digits ROUND_HALF_UP; asserted by the witnesses of INV-041 and INV-044 (derived_views_uow_client_portal)

dispositions.topic_text: Valid decimal shape and scale rules for recognition-item quantity and monetary fields
dispositions.what: the decimal shape NormalizedRecognitionItem's quantity, unit_price and line_total must have (finite Decimal, sign as M-model states, no scale normalization: they are not stored) is stated by the notes of decode_recognition_publication

dispositions.topic_text: Validation precedence when currency and decimal representation are both invalid
dispositions.reason: No precedence is observable: request decoding (A7, decode_recognition_publication) refuses an undecodable amount before any currency check, so a payload invalid in both ways gets the decoding refusal; both refusals change nothing.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether normalized persistence must be verified independently of the operation response
dispositions.what: INV-037 stored form: the operation-level checks read the stored amount back through the repository, not only the operation's answer
